blockingFinding.summary: The irreversible directory ownership transfer is correctly terminal for filesystem work, but the success receipt is allocated, computed and frozen afterward. A synchronous construction fault leaves committed output without a receipt.
requiredCorrection: precompute and freeze the complete immutable receipt before directory fchown
perform the irreversible directory fchown only after receipt construction succeeds
after commit return only the preconstructed reference with no allocation, byte calculation or freeze
prove injected post-commit Object.freeze and finally faults cannot suppress the committed receipt
